Settled on principle (owner, 2026-10-27, vignette 431e12d6: a question a principle already answers is decided by it). This record's own rationale names the principles: one way per goal, and capability layering (semantics live once in the core). Together they pick option A: the exemption belongs in the engine write guard, not the client. Option B adds a second container for the same goal, and option C is client-side semantics.

Acted on (2026-11-27): proposed, in the WG Agent-supported editor log; core change filed as srs-rust#1721; srs-web#634 is blocked by it and no longer needs input. It is ratified at the group's next session.
